metadata.world_axes: X east, Y up, Z south
metadata.local_transform: WGS84 ECEF -> ENU at zero ellipsoidal height; up discarded, Y separately assumed
limitations: All terrain, water, walkway, bridge and stair heights assumed
Building height tags unverified; other heights explicitly estimated
River relation has a missing out-of-AOI member; only the available closed outer 369701032 is used
Official diagram/OSM length difference cause not established; endpoints and definitions require comparison
V5 includes available building:part ways and simple multipolygon parts; completeness not guaranteed
Source and rendering heights are relative, not orthometric elevations; no field validation

part_processing.holes: complete inner rings only; disjoint outer/hole assignment skipped when ambiguous
part_processing.min_height: OSM top height minus min_height for extrusion depth; unknown base defaults to zero
part_processing.parent_overlap: parent shells remain; semantic nesting and field verification pending
